fire: "Have you packed your bags yet?" she asked, leaning on the door.
"That's kind of twisted reasoning, don't you think?" he said.
I suppose that's where whiskey and pills come in, she thought.
"Did you eat your dinner yet?" Mom called up the stairs.
"You've got it all backwards, haven't you?" she muttered.
I guess that's when the nightmares start, he told himself.
"Have you met the new neighbors yet?" he whispered.
"That's such weird thinking, isn't it?" Ben laughed.
